_note: Draft English of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Bereshit 17 (covenant of circumcision; Abram→Abraham renaming). Saadia-specific moves: v.1 אלטאיק אלכאפי = 'the Sufficient Power' (anti-anthropomorphic substitute for אל שדי, parsing שדי as 'who-is-enough' = sufficient); v.5 'Abraham' (post-renaming, used consistently from here on); v.17 וצ'חך סרורא = 'laughed for joy' (Saadia adds 'for joy' — defends Abraham from impiety in laughing at God's promise); v.20 שריפא='noble ones' for נשיאים; v.22, 33 נור אללה = 'the light of God ascended' (substitutes for 'God went up' — avoids spatial language about God).

translations.1: And when Abram became a son of ninety-nine years, God appeared to him, and said to him: 'I am the Sufficient Power; walk in obedience to Me, and be wholesome.
translations.2: And I shall place My covenant between Me and you; and I shall multiply you exceedingly.'
translations.3: And Abram fell upon his face; and God addressed him, saying:
translations.4: 'Behold, I am setting My covenant with you; and you shall be a father of a multitude of nations.
translations.5: And your name shall never again be called Abram; rather, your name shall be Abraham — for I have made you a father of a multitude of nations.
translations.6: And I shall make you grow exceedingly; and I shall make of you nations; and kings shall come forth from you.
translations.7: And I shall establish My covenant between Me and you, and between your offspring after you, for their generations — an eternal covenant — to be your God, and the God of your offspring after you.
translations.8: And I shall give to you, and to your offspring after you, the land of your dwelling — all the land of Canaan — as an eternal possession; and I shall be their God.'
translations.9: Then God said to him: 'And you shall keep My covenant — you and your offspring after you, for their generations.
translations.10: This is My covenant which you shall keep, between Me and you, and your offspring after you: every male among you shall be circumcised.
translations.11: And when you circumcise the foreskin from your bodies, it shall be a sign of the covenant between Me and you.
translations.12: And of eight days shall every male among you be circumcised, for your generations — the one born in your household, and the one bought with money from every foreigner, who is not of your offspring.
translations.13: Surely circumcised shall be the one born in your house, and the one bought for you with money; and My covenant shall be in your bodies as an eternal covenant.
translations.14: And any uncircumcised man who shall not circumcise the foreskin from his body — that man shall be cut off from his people, because he has broken My covenant.'
translations.15: Then God said to Abraham: 'Sarai your wife — you shall not call her name Sarai; rather, her name is Sarah.
translations.16: For I shall bless her; and I shall grant you from her a son; and I shall bless him, and from him shall come nations; and kings of peoples shall come forth from him.'
translations.17: And Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed for joy; and he said in himself: 'Shall a son of a hundred years beget? Or shall Sarah, a daughter of ninety years, bear?'
translations.18: And Abraham said before God: 'O that Ishmael might live with him before You!'
translations.19: And God said: 'But Sarah your wife shall bear you a son; and you shall name him Isaac; and I shall establish My covenant with him as an eternal covenant — and with his offspring after him.
translations.20: And concerning Ishmael — I have accepted your intercession; behold, I am blessing him; and I shall make him grow, and multiply him exceedingly; twelve noble ones shall he beget; and I shall make of him a great nation.
translations.21: And My covenant I shall establish with Isaac, whom Sarah shall bear to you at this time, of the coming year.'
translations.22: And when He had finished speaking with him, the light of God ascended from upon Abraham.
translations.23: And Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all those born in his household, and those bought with money — every man among the people of the house of Abraham — and he circumcised the foreskin from their bodies, on that very day, as God had commanded him.
translations.24: And Abraham was a son of ninety-nine years when he circumcised the foreskin from his body.
translations.25: And Ishmael his son was a son of thirteen years when he circumcised the foreskin from his body.
translations.26: On that very day were Abraham and Ishmael his son circumcised.
translations.27: And every man in his household — the one born in his house, and the one bought with money from every foreigner — were circumcised with him.
